race.comment: BLUE STRATUM (10) produced an excellent effort when finishing runner-up at Cairns over 950m on a rain-affected track last start 9 days ago. He rises in class, but will carry 9.5kg less, and he should be right in the finish again. ALMIGHTY JAB (6) lines up again just 9-days after another honest second-place finish at Cairns. He has never missed a cheque in 6-starts here, and he can go one better. MIND OVER MATTER (13) was not far away when finishing just under 2 lengths from the winner at Mackay just over a fortnight ago, and  he receives a welcome weight drop here. As a winner of 5 in only 9 starts, he commands plenty of respect. ADMITTED (9) made it 2 wins on the bounce with a determined victory at Cairns over 950m, He has to work harder to find the front from a wider gate this time, but he can still complete the hat-trick.
